imageAlt: The Wire EDM Pro premises at Kings Park, Sydney
title: 16/24 Garling Rd, Kings Park
description: The shop has run from this Western Sydney industrial estate for more than 25 years. Every job is quoted, programmed and machined here, under one roof.

imageAlt: The machine shop floor at Wire EDM Pro: Easson optical profile projector and DMG MORI machining centre
title: The machine shop floor
description: Wire EDM, milling and turning sit a few steps apart, so a part moves between processes without leaving the building or the machinist responsible for it.

imageAlt: Workshop interior with mezzanine storage above the machine bays
title: Material and tooling store
description: The mezzanine keeps stock material, tooling and work in progress organised above the floor, close enough that a job never waits on the stores.

imageAlt: Makino U6 H.E.A.T. wire EDM machine cutting a hardened component
title: Makino U6 H.E.A.T. wire EDM
description: The large-travel wire cutter. Profiles to ±0.003 mm in hardened metal up to 420 mm tall, cut after heat treatment so the profile that leaves the machine is the profile that runs.

imageAlt: Fanuc RoboCut C600iA wire EDM on the shop floor
title: Fanuc RoboCut α-C600iA
description: Production wire EDM with automatic wire threading, so repeat profiles keep running between checks instead of waiting for an operator to re-thread.

imageAlt: Second Fanuc RoboCut wire EDM machine with 0iD control
title: The Fanuc wire EDM fleet
description: More than one RoboCut means a long job never queues behind a short one. One-offs, regrinds and small batches keep moving in parallel.

imageAlt: DMG MORI ecoMill 600 V vertical machining centre
title: DMG MORI ecoMill 600 V
description: CNC milling with a 12,000 rpm spindle and a 600 × 560 × 510 mm working envelope. Jigs, fixtures, die sets and production runs.

imageAlt: CNC turning: 3-jaw chuck, carbide insert and spiral chips
title: CNC turning
description: Shafts, bushes, pins and couplings turned to drawing, then finished with wire-cut keyways and splines where the job calls for them.

imageAlt: Close-up of wire EDM spark erosion with dielectric flush
title: Spark erosion, up close
description: The wire never touches the part. Erosion happens across the spark gap under dielectric flush, which is why there is no cutting force, no work hardening and no burr.

imageAlt: EDM drill cutting a fine hole in hardened metal
title: EDM hole drilling
description: Start holes and fine apertures from 0.3 mm to 3.0 mm, eroded in hardened metal without a cutting edge to wander or break.

imageAlt: Workshop bench where finished parts are checked and packed
title: The bench
description: Parts are checked, deburred and packed by hand. The last step before dispatch is always a person, not a machine.

imageAlt: Quality assurance measurement on a wire EDM component
title: Quality control
description: Dimensions, finish and fit verified against the drawing on calibrated instruments. First-article, critical-dimension and batch inspection, before anything leaves the shop.
